system.description:
Ursen Traits

Characters with the ursen heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Age. Ursen mature and age at a similar rate to humans.

Size. Ursen are typically quite tall, with very few standing less than 5 feet. Those who make their homes in more frigid regions are especially tall, easily standing over 7 feet. Most ursen are bulky, weighing over 200 lbs. Your size is Medium.

Speed. Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

Bear Hug. You gain proficiency with Athletics and an expertise die on checks made to grapple an opponent. You also give great hugs.

Broad Build. Your broad shoulders are capable of carrying more weight than most. When determining your carrying capacity and the weight that you can push, drag, or lift, your size is considered to be Large.

Mighty Claws. Your fingers terminate into sharp claws that can be used as natural weapons. Your claws count as finesse weapons, and you are considered to be proficient with them. On a hit, they deal 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (whichever is higher) slashing damage.

Ursen Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your ursen heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Arctic Dweller

You are resistant to cold damage and have advantage on saving throws made to resist the effects of frigid climates.

Additionally, you are specially suited for navigating frozen lands. You ignore difficult terrain caused by deep snow or ice.

Bellowing Roar

As an action, you throw back your head and roar. All creatures within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw versus your maneuver DC or become frightened of you until the start of your next turn. Creatures who succeed on their saving throw are immune to your Bellowing Roar for 24 hours. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Hefty Blows

Your claws gain the breaker property. Additionally, when you attack an unattended object with your claws, you crit on a result of 19–20. If you already have a feature that increases the range of your critical hits, your critical hit range against unattended objects increases by 1 (maximum 17–20).

Ursen Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better ursen and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Go Without

You may consume twice the Supply you ordinarily would for a number of weeks equal to your Constitution modifier. For that number of weeks, you do not need to consume additional Supply, and you do not suffer the effects of going without Supply for the duration. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again for the next month.

King of the Forest

You are permanently under the effects of the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.z5a26lxyh3esw2rl]{Speak with Animals}.

Additionally, once per long rest you may cast the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.k213xxhuazt5uocn]{Awaken} without consuming a spell slot.

Voice of Destruction

Prerequisite: Bellowing Roar heritage gift

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-maneuvers.Item.ti286cy1wamgttiv]{Bloody Roar} combat maneuver and may activate it once per long rest without expending exertion.
